_comment: Phase-5 QAT example: a Brevitas quantization-aware-trained CNN on real 8x8 handwritten digits (sklearn load_digits), exported through penumbra.Model.quantize. Same architecture as phase5_digits_fixture (PTQ); QAT recovers accuracy lost to the 2-bit activation cap. The model is the serialized IR graph under 'graph'; the 10 logits are the graph output and the client argmaxes them. FHE output must equal these quantized-cleartext logits/labels bit-for-bit (see qat_export.py).
